translations.web: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
translations.bsb: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
translations.kjv: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
translations.asv: Take, brethren, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spake in the name of the Lord.
